messages.off_topic: Specialization explanation; clarify; no previous options
messages.unsupported: Reviewed category names for refrigerator, sofa and wardrobe; generic clarification for other unknown words

single_item_rule: All response.options entries have exactly one listing_id; otherwise bundle wording

diagnostics.location: stderr JSON and Server-Timing response header only; no new JSON contract fields
diagnostics.clock: perf_counter for all nested Web stages

limits: 15 observations: P95 and P99 are the maximum under nearest-rank; not a long-run tail estimate
13 controlled-catalogue scenarios and 2 organizer-catalogue scenarios; record counts saved per case
API-call latency includes transport and model response; individual network/queue/inference times not separated
Concrete unsupported names are emitted only for reviewed local labels; other goods receive generic category clarification
No performance optimization or real OpenSearch verification performed
